description: Small engineering acceptance set for local recommendation traceability. It is not an external validity study.

cases.title: Draft the first usable page of a project README
cases.success_criterion: README.md states the project purpose, local setup, and one verified command

cases.title: Prepare a statistical review checklist for a paper
cases.success_criterion: The checklist names every tested claim, its data source, and one recomputation command

cases.title: Plan one week of focused Python learning
cases.success_criterion: The plan contains five dated sessions, each with a runnable exercise and a completion check

cases.title: Verify encrypted backup and restore on a clean profile
cases.success_criterion: A restored profile contains the original goal and excludes a disposable post-backup goal

cases.title: Draft a 200-word abstract for a small research grant
cases.success_criterion: The abstract states the problem, method, evaluation, and one explicit limitation within 200 words

cases.title: Organize notes from five user interviews
cases.success_criterion: The notes contain five anonymized summaries, recurring themes, and unresolved contradictions
